{"code": "### Step: Deduplicate patients based on highest sample_seq
# Since some patients were re-tested (sample_seq = 2), we must keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id

df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now check: how many unique patients remain?
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup.shape[0]}")

# Check: are there still patients with 'severe' severity?
severe_dedup = df_dedup[df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe']
print(f"Number of unique patients with severe disease after deduplication: {severe_dedup.shape[0]}")

# Verify: deduplication preserved the 'severe' group
assert severe_dedup.shape[0] > 0, "No severe patients after deduplication""}
